text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Angolan Foreign Minister Venancio de Moura will lead a delegation to an Organisation for African Unity summit in Togo.
- U.N. Secretary General Kofi Annan told UNITA and MPLA representatives in parliament it was up to the Angolan people to ensure that peace takes hold in the country.
- Angolan President Jose Eduardo dos Santos held brief talks with Tanzanian President Benjamin M'Kapa passing through Luanda on Tuesday on his way to Togo.
- The U.N.'s Annan has appealed to international organisations to come up with $228 million for humanitarian needs in Angola.
